import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'

const registration = readFileSync(new URL('../../../src/views/register/index.vue', import.meta.url), 'utf8')
const button = registration.match(/<el-button(?=[\s\S]*?class="fill-example-action")[\s\S]*?<\/el-button>/)?.[0] || ''
const method = registration.match(/fillBasicExample\(\)\s*\{([\s\S]*?)\n    \},\n    createTempRegistrationAccount\(\)/)?.[1] || ''

assert.ok(button, 'registration must render the prototype sample-fill button')
assert.doesNotMatch(button, /:disabled=/, 'sample-fill must remain available before choosing an organization type')
assert.match(method, /this\.currentCompanyType\s*=\s*['"]01['"]/, 'sample-fill must choose the prototype default developer type')
assert.match(method, /this\.currentBusCode\s*=\s*['"]040100['"]/, 'sample-fill must set the default type business code')
assert.match(method, /registration-uscc-input[\s\S]{0,120}\.focus\(/, 'sample-fill must focus the credit-code input')

console.log('registration sample-fill checks passed')
